text.tspan: Hash of the build artifact from Git commit SHA.
- May also use namespaces or hostname.
- The hostname or IP of the host running the container.
- Helps attestation service connect via SSH.
Request a challenge from the attestation service.
Request an ephemeral secret using the challenge.
Attestation service must now verify that the service is running on the provided host.
- Verifies Runtime ID matches the actual process.
If the runtime state does not match, reject the attestation.

svg.text: Request Ephemeral Secret (Build Hash, Host ID, Challenge)
Compute Signed Payload (Build Hash + Runtime ID + Challenge)
Send Attestation Request (Build Hash, Runtime ID, Host ID, Challenge, Signature)
Verify Challenge is Valid (Check & Mark Used)
Lookup Build Hash in Trusted Registry
Check Image Registry for Build Hash
SSH into Host and Run Validation Script
Check Running Containers (Docker, Containerd, Podman, Kubernetes)
